title: Indiana Avenue fills in from 16th to 18th Street
items: Look west between the houses on Prairie's west side from 16th to 18th Street: Indiana Avenue's east side is no longer bare ground behind them. Five brick houses stand at 1615-1617, 1623, 1703 and 1713, and a row of five more at 209-217 East 16th Street, with six stables on the alley.

Each is drawn from the 1911 fire-insurance map, and only where Robinson's 1886 atlas draws the same building on the lot, so it stood on both sides of 1904. Where the two maps disagree (the corner office, two factories, and three houses that changed or went), the lot stays open until it is read.
